observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show two black game consoles displayed on a glass counter in a phone/gadget shop (McSteve branding on bag and watermark).
The front console has a flat, slab-like design with a visible PlayStation button-symbol logo on the top panel, consistent with a PS4 Pro shape.
A second, slimmer black console sits behind/beside it; its exact model is not distinguishable.
Visible scuff marks, scratches and dust on the top casing of the front unit in both photos.
No controller, power cable, HDMI cable, or power-on screen is shown in either photo.
No serial number, model sticker, or storage capacity label is visible in either image.

identity.kind: PS4 Pro console (shape matches, logo visible but model text not legible)

claims.claim: UK Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: No region sticker, box, or serial visible in either photo; shape is consistent with PS4 Pro but origin cannot be confirmed remotely.
No controller appears in photo 0 or photo 1; only the console units are shown.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common issue with used consoles sold without a power-on demo).
risks.proof: A video or photo of the console powered on showing the PS4 home screen.

risks.risk: No controller is visible despite being listed, so the included accessory cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the actual controller alongside the console, matching serials if possible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no controller

risks.risk: Storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is unstated and unverifiable from photos.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear/bottom label showing capacity, or system settings storage screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced at base/lowest common capacity assumption

risks.risk: Visible scratches/scuffs may indicate heavier wear or prior drops affecting resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides and the disc tray/vents for cracks or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn, lower tier

risks.risk: No power adapter or HDMI cable shown, which are needed for use.
risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no cables

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on to the PS4 home screen.
Photo of the controller included, next to the console.
Photo of the rear label showing model number and storage capacity.
Photo of all included cables and accessories.
Close-up photos of all sides of the console for damage assessment.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by shape as a PS4 Pro console, but the controller claim is contradicted by the photos and no power-on, cable, or capacity proof exists, so it must be priced at worst case as a console-only, unverified-working unit.
